title: minimap
summary: The tile plane is right: md5translate.trs-resolved per-ADT minimap BLPs drawn as a continuous 3x3 neighborhood under a fixed player arrow, 6 zoom steps on wheel + the authored ZoomIn/ZoomOut buttons, circular mask/cluster art, zone detection from ADT area ids driving CMSG_ZONEUPDATE, the tracking button (active tracking aura icon in the MiniMap-TrackingBorder, right-click cancels), the mail icon, party dots, and a resource-node dot layer gated on PLAYER_TRACK_RESOURCES with a GO-template-named hover tooltip through the shared GameTooltip lifecycle. But most of Benilla's byte-verified blip and interior law is absent.

openItems.text: No interior (WMO) minimap: no portal flood-fill group selection, no interior tile stems, and no separate indoor zoom index/radius table {150,120,90,60,40,25} - indoors keeps showing the outdoor ADT plane

Outdoor zoom radii are ad-hoc (halfTile = 0.10 + zoom*0.025 tiles, ~53-120 yd) instead of the verified chunk table {14,12,10,8,6,4}*0.5*33.33 yd (~67-233 yd), so every zoom level shows a different world radius than 1.12
AreaPOI landmark layer missing: no in-range POIIcons cells (Flags&2 rows) and no nearest-3 rotating rim arrows ranked by signed Importance within 694.44 yd
Quest-giver dots missing: DIALOG_STATUS 7 (REWARD2) never draws the gold cell-3 dot
Tracked-creature dots missing: Find Creatures / Hunter's Mark red cell-1 dots are not drawn (only the resource leg exists)
Outdoor tiles are drawn untinted - the reference's day-night MODULATE (ambient/diffuse lerp with +96 floor) is not applied
